title: Elizondo's Imminent: people with Cherokee DNA have more experiences

tellings.quote: You read Luis Elizondo's book Imminent, it's in there. He says it seems to be that people with Cherokee blood and uh DNA have more experiences

plain: People with Cherokee blood and DNA seem to have more encounters with the phenomenon, according to Imminent, a 2024 book by Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who ran a small office that studied UFO reports. Jason Simosa, a researcher who also describes experiences of his own, tells Michels that the claim is "in there" in the book. He does not quote it, so what he gives is his own summary. If true, it would suggest the experiences run in some families or peoples more than others.
